ppi_focus: Rear subframe mounts and trunk floor: inspect spot welds from inside the trunk and the diff ears from below for cracks or tearing; note any reinforcement.
Cooling system: water pump play, radiator end tanks, expansion tank, hoses, thermostat housing; pressure test.
S52 VANOS rattle on cold start; valve cover and oil filter housing gasket leaks; check the 2024 oil pan gasket job.
Front struts left vs right (matching brand and condition), strut mounts, control arm bushings; rear trailing-arm bushings and rear shock mounts.
Power steering pump and hose replaced 2024: check for leaks and noise.
Tire date codes and wear pattern; alignment.
Rust at rockers, floor pans, jack points and under the trunk (humid Southeast history).
Paint meter readings across panels to support the CARFAX no-accident record.
Soft top mechanism and rear window, window regulators, cluster pixels, heated seats, A/C.
Clutch engagement point and slip test, diff noise, scan for stored codes.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: photos or a PPI showing an intact rear subframe and trunk floor (especially with reinforcement plates), plus invoices for cooling components.
Up: invoices for the dealer work and the 2024 Lins service, recent tire date codes, and a clean specialist PPI.
Down: cracks at the diff mounts or trunk floor, evidence of a damaged left front strut or accident repair, or rust at the floors or rockers.
Down: dealer refuses an independent PPI before deposit, or fluid leaks or VANOS faults are found.
evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper it lines up well on paper: an S52 manual M Roadster in a desirable color priced inside the ideal band, so it does not undermine cash preservation. Its keeper case still rests on rear-structure and cooling evidence that is not yet provided.
evidence.rationale: The attached CARFAX verifies identity, a clean title with no brands, no reported accidents, and a coherent odometer trail ending at 51,780 miles, though owner 4's 2009-2019 decade was odometer-exempt. The most substantive documented work is the 02/2024 Lins Automotive visit: coolant flush, diff and trans fluid, engine mounts, oil pan gasket, PS pump and hose, and alignment. Besides that visit, there are no reported service entries between 2010 and 2024. The dealer lists a right-front-only strut replacement, an oil service/inspection and a blower resistor, with no invoices. Photos show a stock, tidy car with good paint and wheels and the two-tone Imola interior, but also bolster and seatback wear and an age-discolored expansion tank. The two model-critical items for an S52 car, rear subframe/trunk-floor condition and cooling-component history, are both undocumented; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply. Ownership turned over three times between 2024 and 2026 with little driving, which warrants questions. At about $18,400 including the admin fee, it sits below the $19,044 fair-value midpoint.
evidence.next_action: Email Godspeed Motors asking for trunk-floor and diff-mount photos, invoices for the listed dealer work and the 2024 Lins service, tire date codes, and written confirmation that an independent BMW specialist PPI can be done in Charlotte before any deposit.
